title: IBCSO: International Bathymetric Chart of the Southern Ocean
description: Cloud-optimized copies of the International Bathymetric Chart of the Southern Ocean grids, with virtual multidimensional indexes (GDAL VRT, Kerchunk, Icechunk, STAC). 500 m grids in EPSG:9354 south of 50 degrees S: bed and ice surface elevation, with source and type identifiers. Holds Version 2 (doi:10.1594/PANGAEA.937574) and archived snapshots of the rolling annual releases, each under its own prefix. Repackaged from the AWI and IBCSO releases, CC BY 4.0. Not for navigation.
